Note to myself, Sunday night. Devika (Mumma).
Irawati asked for ten minutes of cartoons after lunch. I said yes. Then she asked, "Can I finish this episode? It's almost done." Yes. Then, "The next one is short, only fifteen minutes." Yes. Then, "Can I watch with Nani for a bit?"
